result.summary: The page layout is generally clean, but the bottom navigation shows the wrong tab as active for the content being displayed.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' in green as the active tab, but the screen content is the home/discovery feed (delivery address, restaurant search, category filters, and 'Fastest near you'/'Popular right now' lists). The selected tab does not match the displayed content.
issues.suggestion: Set the 'Home' tab as the active/highlighted item while this discovery screen is shown, and only highlight 'Profile' when the profile screen is actually displayed.
